title: Market Analytics & Investment Strategy: NYC Real Estate
text:
Overview
This project conducted a comprehensive spatial and investment analysis across five NYC neighborhoods, integrating GIS datasets to evaluate land use patterns, housing stock, and investment potential.

title: Market Analytics & Investment Strategy: NYC Real Estate
text:
Key Contributions

Spatial Analysis — Mapped land use and housing patterns across five NYC neighborhoods using GIS datasets to surface investment opportunities.
Clustering Analysis — Segmented neighborhoods based on geographic and economic indicators to identify distinct market profiles.
Regression Analysis — Quantified the spatial influence on housing prices to support data-driven investment decisions.

title: AI & Urban-Rural Job Market Disparities
text:
Overview
This analysis examines how AI is reshaping job markets across urban and rural areas, focusing on differences in skill demand, wage patterns, and job distribution.

title: AI & Urban-Rural Job Market Disparities
text:
Key Findings
Using Lightcast job postings, AI-related roles were identified through skill-based keywords and mapped geographically using U.S. Census urban boundaries. The results reveal a clear pattern of inequality:

Urban areas dominate AI job growth, especially for high-skill roles
Rural markets remain limited across all skill levels
AI jobs consistently require higher skills and offer better pay
These advantages are concentrated in cities, reinforcing existing geographic and skill-based disparities rather than distributing opportunities evenly

title: AI & Urban-Rural Job Market Disparities
text:
Tools & Methods
Tools: Python, Lightcast API, U.S. Census Data, GeoPandas
